svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Mill — building tile
svg.desc: Grain into flour. Free extra output on a hills tile or a waterside one (wind and water). The single footprint is 1 cell, worked out from this building's own numbers through the ground model in data/buildingtiles.json. The window is bare paper: this plate has not been drawn yet, and the tile is a playable blank until it is. Generated by tools/build-tiles.mjs from data/buildingtiles.json, data/components.json, data/buildings.json and data/recipes.json - do not edit. 1 cell of 16.7 mm across the flats, which is a world-map hex on the korvane-reach four-sheet preset and a mini-map cell; 16.7 x 19.28 mm inside a 2 mm bleed, at 8 units/mm. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
